source: Thing2 local OPT-125M LittleBit-2 exploratory checkpoint
limitations: The original checkpoint contains duplicated or nonoptimal storage structures. This is a serialization and tied-embedding packaging test, not a change in network parameter count or a new quantization-aware training run.
CPU loader logit parity was validated for this storage variant, but GPU performance, useful model quality and native Strata/Ollama serving were not validated.
The model still has the same 125M nominal parameters. Disk size is not equivalent to realized bits-per-weight or runtime memory.
Optimized model weights/checkpoint are deliberately not distributed in this repository.
